spec.goal: Have the agents make something that comes across as cool, with the specific kind of thing left open because the request does not say.
spec.deliverable: A single creative piece of work chosen from the agents' areas of work (such as a web page, app, copy, or visual style), presented with a short note on what it is.
constraints: The request gives no topic, format, audience, or style, so the work should stay general and not assume any of these.
Keep the scope to one self-contained deliverable rather than several.
done_criteria: One complete deliverable is handed back and can be used or viewed as is.
A short note states what was made and what it is meant to be.
The deliverable adds no features, integrations, links, or payments that the request did not ask for.
spec.summary: You asked for something cool without giving details, so we understood this as a request for one self-contained creative piece, kept general because no topic or format was specified.
